subject: Intro: Redwood demo & pricing — BlueHarbor (budget intent)
messages:
From: Morgan Turner <morgan.turner@blueharbor.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-01T16:42:00-07:00
Subject: Intro: Redwood demo & pricing — BlueHarbor (budget intent)

Hi Aditya / Irene,

I filled out the pricing form on your site and was routed here — thanks for the quick turnaround. BlueHarbor is evaluating inference platforms to power our fraud-detection enrichment and customer messaging personalization. We have a Q4 budget roughly in the $80k–120k/year range and would like a product demo focused on latency, multi-tenant isolation, and cost controls for embeddings.

Key context:
- Primary use: real-time enrichment for payments fraud signals (sub-500ms target).
- Data sensitivity: PII-lite but need audit logs + retention controls.
- Current infra: mix of GCP and on-prem PostgreSQL.

Would like a 30–45m demo next week to go over pricing/architecture and get a sense of any enterprise needs. I attached a short RFP summary. Can you share availability?

Thanks,
Morgan Turner
Director, Engineering
BlueHarbor Payments

Attachment: BlueHarbor_RFP_summary.pdf
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Morgan Turner <morgan.turner@blueharbor.com>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-01T17:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intro: Redwood demo & pricing — BlueHarbor (budget intent)

Hi Morgan — great to meet you and thanks for the RFP summary. I own early demos for accounts in your bracket; copying Irene (AE) and Marissa (Solutions) to make sure we cover architecture and pricing.

Quick options: I have these 30–40m slots open next week (PST):
- Tue 11/03 10:00–10:40
- Wed 11/04 14:00–14:40
- Fri 11/06 11:00–11:40

If none of those work, feel free to pick a time on my calendar: https://calendly.com/redwood/aditya-30min

Before we lock time, two quick prep items so we tailor the demo:
1) Are you primarily evaluating hosted API or considering private (VPC/on-prem) as well?
2) Typical seq length / tokens per request (ballpark).

Irene / Marissa — any special areas you want to call out in the initial session?

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
SDR, Redwood Inference
From: Morgan Turner <morgan.turner@blueharbor.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Cc: Jaya Srivastava <j.srivastava@blueharbor.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-01T20:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intro: Redwood demo & pricing — BlueHarbor (budget intent)

Hi Aditya — thanks. Appreciate the options.

Quick answers:
- We're leaning hosted first to move faster, but need clear private deployment path if controls demand it.
- Typical request: 128–256 tokens for enrichment, spikes up to ~1k during batch windows.

Unfortunately Tue/Wed are tight for our engineering leads. Friday 11/06 11:00 PST works for me but Jaya (copied) would prefer a 30m slot at 09:30 PST if that's possible. If 09:30 is a hard no on your side, we can do 11:00.

Morgan
From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
To: Morgan Turner <morgan.turner@blueharbor.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-02T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intro: Redwood demo & pricing — BlueHarbor (budget intent)

Hi Morgan / Jaya — great to meet you. Thanks for the RFP and the quick context; that's super helpful.

We can do Friday 11/06 at 09:30 PST for a focused 30-minute session. I reserved that slot on our side and attached a short agenda so you know what to expect. If you'd like a deeper architecture + cost workshop after the intro, we can schedule a follow-up 60m session with Solutions (Marissa) and our Applied ML lead.

Agenda (attached): 1) Quick intros + goals (5m) 2) Demo: latency/cost controls, KV cache, and routing policies (15m) 3) Q&A + next steps (10m).

Please confirm and I'll send a calendar invite with a Zoom link.

Best,
Irene Choi
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
irene_choi@redwood.com | (415) 555-0127
